title: Germany: Thieves break in to thousands of safes, stealing 30 million euros
summary: Robbers used a large drill to break into a German savings bank's vault room and steal cash, gold and jewelry worth some €30 million ($35 million), police said Tuesday. While the criminals remained at large, hundreds of distressed bank customers massed outside the branch on Tuesday demanding information, but were kept at bay by police. Story by Eliza Herbert…
